title: Pharma crossword
description: Use the clues to find the words from our classes.

entries.clue: A written order from a doctor that lets you get a medicine.
A hormone, also a medicine, that controls the sugar in your blood.
A legal right that stops other companies from making your invention.
A ___ drug has the same active ingredient as a brand-name drug but costs less.
A company that buys large quantities from manufacturers and sells to pharmacies.
A company that pays part of your medical costs.
A body temperature that is higher than normal.
Swelling, redness and pain in a part of the body.
A protein that speeds up chemical reactions in the body.
A substance made of two or more elements chemically combined.
To take something out of a material, often using a solvent.
